action_items_for_attackers: Weight function-word + formula cribs over Les-Mis bigram rates until the era corpus lands.
Priority drag targets: j'ai l'honneur de, monsieur, considération, assurance, dépêche, excellence, agréez (segmentations above; 5-20x expected rates).
Use 1835/1878 spellings in all cribs: collége, poëte, rhythme, asyle.
Single letters l,d,s,m,n,j,t,c,i,e,é,a,y,à are first-class groups (elision system).
Kill any candidate reading containing 'ça'; expect cela.
Rebalance person priors: je/vous up, il-narration down.

epistolary_adjustments_INF: il/elle/ils/dit/répondit: expect well below novel rates; despatches report, they do not narrate.
je > nous in despatches (envoy writes as individual reporter).
ne...point still live in formal 1840s prose alongside ne...pas.
Subjunctive/formula triggers (veuillez, je vous prie de) are formulaic, novel-rare.

formulae.note: shape OBS from Talbot 1839/1840 datelines; city spelling + exact form unverified

formulae.formula: J'ai l'honneur de vous informer que
En réponse à la dépêche de Votre Excellence du [date]
J'ai l'honneur d'accuser à Votre Excellence réception de sa dépêche du
Agréez, Monsieur, l'assurance de ma haute considération.
J'ai l'honneur d'être avec la plus haute considération, Monsieur, Votre très humble et obéissant serviteur
J'ai l'honneur d'être avec la considération la plus parfaite, etc.
Je renouvelle à V. Exe. l'assurance de ma considération distinguée

cela_vs_ca.verdict: In diplomatic register, ca is effectively absent. A candidate reading producing 'ça' should be killed.

function_words_era_rates.note: DER: Google Books French ngrams 2012 (corpus=19), mean 1835-1850, fraction of tokens.

les_mis_traps: Person system: novel = il/elle + dialogue tags; despatch = je/vous formulae. Les-Mis n-grams overweight il-initial and dialogue bigrams.
cela-rate match for 87=ce is weak evidence: cela dominates in EVERY register (47:1), not just novels.
Hugo's argot/neologisms/foreign inserts add syllables the 1841 chancery key never used.
Orthography is the least-mismatched axis (both pre-1878); the correction needed is cribs in 1835 spellings, not era adjustment of the model.
Sentence cadence: Les Mis short dramatic sentences vs despatch long periodic sentences with nested subordinates.
Formula density: 'J'ai l'honneur', 'assurance de ma haute considération', 'Votre Excellence' ~0x in Les Mis, dozens per despatch; Les-Mis-trained solver treats them as improbable - exactly backwards.

meta.note: Status marks: OBS=observed/quoted from source, DER=computed, INF=inference (do not treat as fact). Full prose + provenance in linguist_results.md.

orthography_1841.crib_spelling_warning: Use 1835/1878 spellings in cribs: collége, poëte, rhythme, asyle. Modern spellings may fail on one letter.

syllable_tiers.note: Tier 0/1/2 from DER syllabification of 98,229 words of Meisel 1826 diplomatic French (178,188 syllable tokens; +/-10% noise from OCR + ad-hoc syllabifier). Cross-checked qualitatively against Chetail & Mathey (2010) top-10 orthographic syllables: ment, a, dé, té, tion, ter, é, ti, ma, ca. Dominant structure CV 26.4%, CVC 15.4% (Chetail-Mathey OBS).
syllable_tiers.note_single_letters: Mechanism: elision (l', d', s', m', j', n', qu') + silent final -e. Anchors 82=m, 34=i, 40=e consistent.
